data.name: VectorLimits
data.value: Creates real polygon paths, not an embedded bitmap. Best for flat logos and simple illustrations; photos, gradients, fine text and smooth curves lose detail. Color mode quantizes colors and alpha; black/white mode thresholds brightness and alpha. Processing uses a 256/512/1024 px working grid while retaining original display size. Source limit: 16 million pixels; complexity: 250,000 boundary edges; SVG: 5 MiB. Transparent-only or overly complex inputs fail.
